What time is it, Mr Wolf?
Creep up close —
ask the wolf the time!
🦝 Let's play!
One o'clock!

tiptoe, tiptoe!
🐺 One o'clock!
Three o'clock!
Take three steps —
closer, closer!
🐺 Three o'clock!
Six o'clock!
Nearly there —
shhh, so close!
🦝 Almost!
DINNER TIME!
The wolf turns around —
run, run, run! Ha, ha, ha!
🐺 Dinner time!
Let's eat together!
The friendly wolf shares his picnic —
What time is it? Dinner time!
🦝🐺 Yummy!
